---
title: "Per-tumour differential expression"
author: "Rayane Achebouche"
date: "2025-02-07"
output: html_document
---

Repeats the tumour-vs-normal comparison **one tumour at a time**: each of the
1,092 TCGA-BRCA primary tumours is tested against the whole set of GTEx normal
breast samples. This gives a per-patient deregulation profile, which is what
`analyses/05_cell_to_tissue/` compares with the compound signatures (Figure 5).

Writes one file per tumour into `../../data/external/DGE_results_indiv/`
(1,092 files, ~2.2 GB — not tracked by git).

⚠️ A single-tumour design has no replication on the tumour side: the dispersion
is estimated from the normal samples alone. The resulting statistics are used as
a *ranking* of genes within each tumour, not as calibrated p-values.

```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)
```

## Count matrix

```{r counts}
exprFinal <- read.csv("../../data/external/TCGA/DGEA_Protocol/ExpressionProfiles_GTEX-TCGA.csv")
exprBT <- exprFinal[, -c(1:3)]
rownames(exprBT) <- exprFinal$gene
exprBT <- round((2^exprBT) - 1, 0)

exprBT_GTEX <- exprBT[, startsWith(names(exprBT), "GTEX")]
exprBT_TCGA <- exprBT[, startsWith(names(exprBT), "TCGA")]

cat(ncol(exprBT_GTEX), "normal samples,", ncol(exprBT_TCGA), "tumours\n")
```

## One comparison per tumour

```{r function}
# All GTEx samples as group 0, the single tumour as group 1.
group <- as.factor(c(rep(0, ncol(exprBT_GTEX)), 1))

dgea_one_tumour <- function(counts, group) {
  y <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = group)
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = group)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- normLibSizes(y)

  design <- model.matrix(~group)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design = design)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design = design)
  lrt <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)

  results <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  results$gene <- rownames(results)
  results$z_score <- scale(results$logFC)
  results %>% select(gene, everything())
}
```

```{r run, eval=FALSE}
# Long: one edgeR fit per tumour. Set eval=TRUE to regenerate.
outdir <- "../../data/external/DGE_results_indiv"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (i in seq_along(names(exprBT_TCGA))) {
  counts <- cbind(exprBT_GTEX, exprBT_TCGA[i])
  results <- dgea_one_tumour(counts, group)
  write.csv(results, file.path(outdir, paste0("results_", names(exprBT_TCGA)[i], ".csv")))
}
```
